purpose: Whole-network CIC2017 PCAP corpus with three-state labels, time-forward split within capture and family, flow-statistics and frozen netFound views over the same flows, three-layer identical-input audit with oracle ceilings, and paired few-shot curves. Companion of EXP94 CSV run and EXP93.
label_rule_note: Rules transcribed from the CNS2022 corrected CICIDS2017 notebook; attempted categories and evidence-condition failures are unresolved (label None), never benign.

corpus.note: null retention keeps every flow in every split; set train caps only if frozen-encoder time becomes prohibitive and record it

netfound-v2-small.feature_description: 512-dimensional frozen netFound v2 header/timing representation, projected to 64 dimensions with training-split PCA. Raw payload, IP addresses, ports, absolute timestamps, labels and split are excluded from encoder input.

projection.fit_scope: all training-split corpus flows, including unresolved flows; neither validation nor test flows are used

fewshot.interpretation: with_benign is primary; attack_only diagnostic; the same flow IDs feed flowstats-v1 and netfound-v2-small views

flow_note: reorder window 5 s: the whole-network captures show small packet disorder (CNS2022 ran reordercap); a flow is only rejected if disorder exceeds this window.

captures.capture_note: Notebook cell 2 labels every Monday flow BENIGN (label_rest_as_benign_and_write_csv only); no attack rules exist.
